items.source: Uses of AbstractUrlViewController in org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc
Simple Controller implementation that transforms the virtual path of a URL into a view name and returns that view.
items.translation: 简单的Controller实现，它将 URL 的虚拟路径转换为视图名称并返回该视图。
